about.intro_content: Prof. Xiang-Ming Lao is a Professor in the Department of Pancreaticobiliary Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, specialising in hepatobiliary and pancreatic tumour surgery.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Lao has contributed to multicentre research on the impact of antiviral therapy on survival outcomes for hepatocellular carcinoma patients treated with chemoembolisation, published in the Chinese Journal of Cancer. His practice at SYSUCC's Department of Pancreaticobiliary Surgery covers surgical treatment of liver, gallbladder, bile duct and pancreatic tumours.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Xiang-Ming Lao

items.question: Does Prof. Xiang-Ming Lao accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to hepatobiliary or pancreatic cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Lao's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Lao specialises in the surgical treatment of hepatobiliary tumours and pancreatic cancer.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Has Prof. Lao contributed to liver cancer research?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Lao co-authored research examining the impact of antiviral therapy on survival outcomes for hepatocellular carcinoma patients treated with chemoembolisation.
